g.ask: Ask the county FSA office for “the 2026 ARC-CO benchmark yield for my county, crop and practice (irrigated or non-irrigated)”, or look it up in FSA’s program data (file: ARC-CO benchmark yields and revenues, program year 2026). Then type it into the calculator.
dl: Do nothing for 2026 and that farm gets no 2026 payment.
Producers with a share in the crop sign. FSA says a landowner with no share interest, such as a cash-rent landlord, cannot enroll.
Bring the farm’s FSA-156EZ. It lists the base acres and PLC yields.
